source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And spoke Yahweh to Moses, saying,

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Moses, saying,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses,

es.L: Y habló {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Moisés, diciendo:
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Moisés:
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Moisés:

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parla à Moïse, en disant :
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse :
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Moïse :

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akanena na Musa, akisema,
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa hivi,

decisions.choice: spoke ... saying: the opening of a divine speech
decisions.reason: The formula introduces God's last instructions in the book (verses 2-15): how the tabernacle, made in chapters 36-39, is to be set up and anointed, and how the priests are to be installed.

decisions.choice: said
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the plain verb; Literal keeps "spoke ... saying".

decisions.choice: passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("parla", "dit", "dressa"); passé composé at Readable ("a dit", "a dressé")
decisions.reason: As the French style guide sets out: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and read in school today. This applies to the narrative of verses 16-38; God's instructions in verses 2-15 use the future (L, B) and the imperative (R).

source.text: בְּיוֹם־הַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ תָּקִ֕ים אֶת־מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: On [the] day of the month the first, on [the] first of the month, you will set up the tabernacle of [the] tent of meeting.

en.L: "On the day of the first month, on the first of the month, you shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
en.B: "On the first day of the first month, set up the tabernacle, the tent of meeting.
en.R: "On the first day of the first month, set up the tabernacle, the sacred tent. It is the tent of meeting.

es.L: «En el día del mes primero, el primero del mes, levantarás el tabernáculo de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.B: «El primer día del mes primero levantarás el tabernáculo, la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.R: «El primer día del primer mes, levanta el tabernáculo, la tienda sagrada. Es la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: « Au jour du premier mois, le premier du mois, tu dresseras la Demeure de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.B: « Le premier jour du premier mois, tu dresseras la Demeure, la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.R: « Le premier jour du premier mois, dresse le tabernacle, la tente sacrée. C’est la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: "Siku ya mwezi wa kwanza, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi, utaisimamisha maskani ya Hema la Kukutania.
sw.B: "Siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza, isimamishe maskani, yaani Hema la Kukutania.
sw.R: "Siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza, simamisha maskani, yaani hema takatifu. Ndilo Hema la Kukutania.

decisions.choice: on the first day of the first month: New Year's Day
decisions.reason: The date is given twice, as "the day of the first month" and "the first of the month": the first day of the first month, the month of the Passover (12:2). Verse 17 says which year: the second year after Israel left Egypt.

decisions.choice: the tabernacle of the tent of meeting: one structure with two names
alternatives: the tabernacle and the tent of meeting
decisions.reason: "Tabernacle" (dwelling) names the place where God lives among his people; "tent of meeting" names it as the place where he meets with them (29:42-43). The phrase joins the two names for the one tent.

decisions.choice: the tabernacle, the tent of meeting
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable set the second name beside the first; Literal keeps "the tabernacle of the tent of meeting".

decisions.choice: the sacred tent
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word "tabernacle" the first time it appears in the chapter, as 25:9 and 26:1 do.

source.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְסַכֹּתָ֥ עַל־הָאָרֹ֖ן אֶת־הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put there the ark of the testimony, and you will screen over the ark the veil.

en.L: And you shall put there the ark of the testimony, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
en.B: Place the ark of the testimony in it, and screen the ark off with the curtain.
en.R: Put the ark that holds the covenant tablets inside it. Then hang the inner curtain in front of the ark to screen it off.

es.L: Y pondrás allí el arca del Testimonio, y ocultarás el arca con el velo.
es.B: Colocarás en él el arca del Testimonio y la ocultarás tras la cortina interior.
es.R: Pon dentro el arca donde están las tablas del pacto. Luego cuelga la cortina interior delante del arca para ocultarla.

fr.L: Et tu y placeras l’arche du Témoignage, et tu masqueras l’arche avec le voile.
fr.B: Tu y placeras l’arche du Témoignage, et tu la cacheras derrière le rideau intérieur.
fr.R: Mets à l’intérieur l’arche où se trouvent les tablettes de l’alliance. Puis suspends le rideau intérieur devant l’arche pour la cacher.

sw.L: Nawe utaliweka humo sanduku la Ushuhuda, nawe utalisitiri sanduku kwa pazia.
sw.B: Utaliweka humo sanduku la Ushuhuda, na kulisitiri kwa pazia la ndani.
sw.R: Weka ndani yake sanduku lenye vibao vya agano. Kisha tundika pazia la ndani mbele ya sanduku ili kulificha.

decisions.choice: screen the ark with the veil: shut it off from view
alternatives: cover the ark with the veil
decisions.reason: The verb means to cover or shield. The veil does not lie on the ark; it hangs in front of it and divides the most holy place from the holy place (26:33).

decisions.choice: the ark of the testimony: the chest that holds the tablets
decisions.reason: "The testimony" is the stone tablets of the covenant (25:16; 31:18), and the ark is named for them.

decisions.choice: curtain
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "curtain" (Readable "inner curtain"), as in 26:31-35; Literal keeps "veil".

decisions.choice: the ark that holds the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the ark of the testimony" is, as in 25:22.

source.text: וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן וְעָרַכְתָּ֖ אֶת־עֶרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֔ה וְהַעֲלֵיתָ֖ אֶת־נֵרֹתֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will bring in the table, and you will arrange its arrangement; and you will bring in the lampstand, and you will set up its lamps.

en.L: And you shall bring in the table and set in order its arrangement, and you shall bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.
en.B: Bring in the table and set out in order what belongs on it. Bring in the lampstand and mount its lamps.
en.R: Bring in the table and lay out the bread on it in rows. Bring in the lampstand and put its lamps in place.

es.L: Y meterás la mesa, y pondrás en orden su arreglo; y meterás el candelabro, y colocarás sus lámparas.
es.B: Meterás la mesa y dispondrás en orden lo que va sobre ella. Meterás el candelabro y montarás sus lámparas.
es.R: Mete la mesa y coloca el pan sobre ella en hileras. Mete el candelabro y pon sus lámparas en su lugar.

fr.L: Et tu feras entrer la table, et tu mettras en ordre son arrangement ; et tu feras entrer le chandelier, et tu installeras ses lampes.
fr.B: Tu apporteras la table et tu y disposeras en ordre ce qui doit s’y trouver. Tu apporteras le chandelier et tu y installeras ses lampes.
fr.R: Apporte la table et dispose le pain dessus en rangées. Apporte le chandelier et mets ses lampes en place.

sw.L: Nawe utaileta ndani meza, nawe utapanga mpangilio wake; nawe utakileta ndani kinara cha taa, nawe utazipandisha taa zake.
sw.B: Utaileta meza ndani na kupanga juu yake kwa utaratibu vitu vinavyowekwa juu yake. Utakileta kinara cha taa na kuzipandisha taa zake.
sw.R: Ilete meza ndani, na upange mikate juu yake kwa safu. Kilete kinara cha taa, na uweke taa zake mahali pake.

decisions.choice: its arrangement: the bread set out in rows
decisions.reason: The noun means things laid out in order. Verse 23 calls it "an arrangement of bread": the bread of the Presence, set out in two rows (25:30; Leviticus 24:5-6).

decisions.choice: set up its lamps: mount the lamps on the lampstand
decisions.reason: The verb means to raise up. Here it most likely means placing the seven lamps on top of the lampstand (25:37). It may also mean lighting them (see verse 25).

decisions.choice: lay out the bread on it in rows
decisions.reason: Readable says what the arrangement was, from verse 23.

source.text: וְנָתַתָּ֞ה אֶת־מִזְבַּ֤ח הַזָּהָב֙ לִקְטֹ֔רֶת לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת וְשַׂמְתָּ֛ אֶת־מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put the altar of the gold for incense before [the] ark of the testimony, and you will put the screen of the entrance to the tabernacle.

en.L: And you shall put the altar of gold for incense before the ark of the testimony, and you shall put [in place] the screen of the entrance to the tabernacle.
en.B: Place the gold altar for incense in front of the ark of the testimony, and hang the screen at the entrance to the tabernacle.
en.R: Put the gold altar for burning incense in front of the ark that holds the covenant tablets, on the outer side of the inner curtain. Then hang the screen at the entrance to the tabernacle.

es.L: Y pondrás el altar de oro para el incienso delante del arca del Testimonio, y pondrás [en su lugar] la cortina de la entrada del tabernáculo.
es.B: Colocarás el altar de oro para el incienso delante del arca del Testimonio, y colgarás la cortina a la entrada del tabernáculo.
es.R: Pon el altar de oro para quemar incienso frente al arca donde están las tablas del pacto, pero por fuera de la cortina interior. Luego cuelga la cortina a la entrada del tabernáculo.

fr.L: Et tu placeras l’autel d’or pour l’encens devant l’arche du Témoignage, et tu mettras [en place] le rideau de l’entrée de la Demeure.
fr.B: Tu placeras l’autel d’or pour l’encens devant l’arche du Témoignage, et tu suspendras le rideau à l’entrée de la Demeure.
fr.R: Mets l’autel d’or où l’on brûle l’encens en face de l’arche où se trouvent les tablettes de l’alliance, mais à l’extérieur du rideau intérieur. Puis suspends le rideau à l’entrée du tabernacle.

sw.L: Nawe utaiweka madhabahu ya dhahabu kwa ajili ya uvumba mbele ya sanduku la Ushuhuda, nawe utaweka [mahali pake] pazia la mlango wa maskani.
sw.B: Utaiweka madhabahu ya dhahabu ya uvumba mbele ya sanduku la Ushuhuda, na kutundika pazia la mlango wa maskani.
sw.R: Weka madhabahu ya dhahabu ya kufukizia uvumba mbele ya sanduku lenye vibao vya agano, lakini upande wa nje wa pazia la ndani. Kisha tundika pazia kwenye mlango wa maskani.

decisions.choice: before the ark: in front of the veil that hides the ark
decisions.reason: The incense altar stood in the holy place, outside the veil, facing the ark behind it (30:6; 40:26). It was not inside the most holy place.

decisions.choice: the screen of the entrance: the hanging at the door of the tent
decisions.reason: This is the embroidered screen at the doorway of the tent itself (26:36-37), not the screen at the gate of the courtyard (verse 8).

decisions.choice: on the outer side of the inner curtain
decisions.reason: Readable says where the altar stood, so that "in front of the ark" is not read as inside the most holy place.

source.text: וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֕י פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֥ן אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put the altar of the burnt offering before [the] entrance of [the] tabernacle of [the] tent of meeting.

en.L: And you shall put the altar of burnt offering before the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
en.B: Set the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting.
en.R: Put the altar for burnt offerings in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting.

es.L: Y pondrás el altar del holocausto delante de la entrada del tabernáculo de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.B: Colocarás el altar del holocausto delante de la entrada del tabernáculo, la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.R: Pon el altar para los holocaustos frente a la entrada del tabernáculo, la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: Et tu placeras l’autel de l’holocauste devant l’entrée de la Demeure de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.B: Tu installeras l’autel de l’holocauste devant l’entrée de la Demeure, la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.R: Mets l’autel des holocaustes devant l’entrée du tabernacle, la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: Nawe utaiweka madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa mbele ya mlango wa maskani ya Hema la Kukutania.
sw.B: Utaiweka madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa mbele ya mlango wa maskani, yaani Hema la Kukutania.
sw.R: Weka madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketezwa mbele ya mlango wa maskani, yaani Hema la Kukutania.

decisions.choice: the altar of burnt offering: the bronze altar in the courtyard
decisions.reason: The large altar of acacia wood overlaid with bronze (27:1-8) stood in the courtyard, in front of the tent's entrance, where the offerings were burned.

source.text: וְנָֽתַתָּ֙ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖ם מָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put the basin between [the] tent of meeting and the altar, and you will put there water.

en.L: And you shall put the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and you shall put water there.
en.B: Place the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
en.R: Put the bronze basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and fill it with water.

es.L: Y pondrás la pila entre la Tienda del Encuentro y el altar, y pondrás allí agua.
es.B: Colocarás la pila entre la Tienda del Encuentro y el altar, y echarás agua en ella.
es.R: Pon la pila de bronce entre la Tienda del Encuentro y el altar, y llénala de agua.

fr.L: Et tu placeras la cuve entre la tente de la Rencontre et l’autel, et tu y mettras de l’eau.
fr.B: Tu placeras la cuve entre la tente de la Rencontre et l’autel, et tu y verseras de l’eau.
fr.R: Mets la cuve de bronze entre la tente de la Rencontre et l’autel, et remplis-la d’eau.

sw.L: Nawe utaliweka birika kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, nawe utatia maji humo.
sw.B: Utaliweka birika kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, na kutia maji ndani yake.
sw.R: Weka birika la shaba kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, na ulijaze maji.

decisions.choice: the basin: the bronze washbasin for the priests
decisions.reason: The basin of bronze held water for the priests to wash their hands and feet before they served (30:17-21; verses 30-32).

decisions.choice: bronze
decisions.reason: Readable adds what the basin was made of (30:18).

source.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֑יב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ אֶת־מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶחָצֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will set up the courtyard all around, and you will put the screen of [the] gate of the courtyard.

en.L: And you shall set up the courtyard all around, and you shall put [in place] the screen of the gate of the courtyard.
en.B: Set up the courtyard all around it, and hang the screen at the gate of the courtyard.
en.R: Set up the courtyard all around it, and hang the screen at the courtyard's gate.

es.L: Y pondrás el atrio alrededor, y pondrás [en su lugar] la cortina de la puerta del atrio.
es.B: Levantarás el atrio todo alrededor y colgarás la cortina a la puerta del atrio.
es.R: Arma el atrio alrededor de todo, y cuelga la cortina en la puerta del atrio.

fr.L: Et tu installeras le parvis tout autour, et tu mettras [en place] le rideau de la porte du parvis.
fr.B: Tu dresseras le parvis tout autour, et tu suspendras le rideau à la porte du parvis.
fr.R: Installe le parvis tout autour, et suspends le rideau à la porte du parvis.

sw.L: Nawe utauweka ua kuzunguka pande zote, nawe utaweka [mahali pake] pazia la lango la ua.
sw.B: Utausimamisha ua kuzunguka pande zote, na kutundika pazia la lango la ua.
sw.R: Simamisha ua kuizunguka maskani, na utundike pazia kwenye lango la ua.

decisions.choice: the courtyard and its gate: the linen enclosure around the tent
decisions.reason: The courtyard was fenced with linen hangings on posts, with an embroidered screen across its gate on the east side (27:9-16).

source.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֖יו וְהָ֥יָה קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will take [the] oil of the anointing, and you will anoint the tabernacle and all that [is] in it, and you will consecrate it and all its articles, and it will be holy.

en.L: And you shall take the oil of anointing and anoint the tabernacle and all that [is] in it, and you shall consecrate it and all its articles, and it shall be holy.
en.B: Then take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it. Consecrate it and all its furnishings, and it will be holy.
en.R: Then take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything inside it. In this way you will set it and all its furnishings apart for God, and it will be holy.

es.L: Y tomarás el aceite de la unción, y ungirás el tabernáculo y todo lo que [hay] en él, y lo consagrarás a él y todos sus utensilios, y será santo.
es.B: Luego tomarás el aceite de la unción y ungirás el tabernáculo y todo lo que hay en él. Lo consagrarás con todo su mobiliario, y será santo.
es.R: Después toma el aceite de la unción y unge el tabernáculo y todo lo que hay dentro. Así lo apartarás para Dios, con todo su mobiliario, y será santo.

fr.L: Et tu prendras l’huile d’onction, et tu oindras la Demeure et tout ce qui [est] en elle, et tu la consacreras ainsi que tous ses objets, et elle sera sainte.
fr.B: Puis tu prendras l’huile d’onction et tu oindras la Demeure et tout ce qu’elle contient. Tu la consacreras avec tout son mobilier, et elle sera sainte.
fr.R: Ensuite, prends l’huile d’onction et oins le tabernacle et tout ce qui s’y trouve. Ainsi, tu le mettras à part pour Dieu, avec tout son mobilier, et il sera saint.

sw.L: Nawe utayatwaa mafuta ya kupaka, nawe utaipaka mafuta maskani na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, nawe utaitakasa, pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote, nayo itakuwa takatifu.
sw.B: Kisha utachukua mafuta ya kupaka na kuipaka mafuta maskani na kila kitu kilichomo ndani yake. Utaitakasa pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote, nayo itakuwa takatifu.
sw.R: Kisha chukua mafuta ya kupaka, uipake maskani na kila kitu kilichomo ndani yake. Kwa njia hiyo utaitenga kwa ajili ya Mungu pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote, nayo itakuwa takatifu.

decisions.choice: the anointing oil: the holy oil made by the recipe of 30:22-33
decisions.reason: The oil was made only for this use (30:31-33). Putting it on the tent, its furnishings and the priests marked them as belonging to God.

decisions.choice: consecrate ... holy: set apart as belonging to God
decisions.reason: To consecrate is to make holy: to set something apart from common use for God's service alone.

decisions.choice: set ... apart for God
decisions.reason: Readable explains "consecrate", as in 30:29; Literal and Balanced keep "consecrate".

source.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֛ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will anoint [the] altar of the burnt offering and all its articles, and you will consecrate the altar, and will be the altar holiness of holinesses.

en.L: And you shall anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its articles, and you shall consecrate the altar, and the altar shall be holy of holies.
en.B: Anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils. Consecrate the altar, and it will be most holy.
en.R: Anoint the altar for burnt offerings and all the things used with it. Set the altar apart for God, and it will be most holy.

es.L: Y ungirás el altar del holocausto y todos sus utensilios, y consagrarás el altar, y será el altar santo de santos.
es.B: Ungirás el altar del holocausto y todos sus utensilios. Consagrarás el altar, y será santísimo.
es.R: Unge el altar para los holocaustos y todas las cosas que se usan con él. Aparta el altar para Dios, y será muy santo.

fr.L: Et tu oindras l’autel de l’holocauste et tous ses ustensiles, et tu consacreras l’autel, et l’autel sera saint des saints.
fr.B: Tu oindras l’autel de l’holocauste et tous ses ustensiles. Tu consacreras l’autel, et il sera très saint.
fr.R: Oins l’autel des holocaustes et tout ce qui sert avec lui. Mets l’autel à part pour Dieu, et il sera très saint.

sw.L: Nawe utaipaka mafuta madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na vyombo vyake vyote, nawe utaitakasa madhabahu, nayo madhabahu itakuwa utakatifu wa vitakatifu.
sw.B: Utaipaka mafuta madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na vyombo vyake vyote. Utaitakasa madhabahu, nayo itakuwa takatifu kabisa.
sw.R: Ipake mafuta madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketezwa na vitu vyote vinavyotumika nayo. Itenge madhabahu kwa ajili ya Mungu, nayo itakuwa takatifu sana.

decisions.choice: holy of holies: most holy
decisions.reason: Repeating the noun in the plural makes a superlative. The altar is "most holy", as in 29:37, where anything that touches it becomes holy.

decisions.choice: most holy
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the superlative; Literal keeps "holy of holies".

decisions.choice: "saint des saints" (L), with no article
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew superlative as English Literal does. Without the article it describes the altar and is not the name of the inner room, "le lieu très saint"; Balanced and Readable say "très saint".

source.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־כַּנּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will anoint the basin and its stand, and you will consecrate it.

en.L: And you shall anoint the basin and its stand, and you shall consecrate it.
en.B: Anoint the basin with its stand, and consecrate it.
en.R: Anoint the bronze basin and its stand, and set it apart for God.

es.L: Y ungirás la pila y su base, y la consagrarás.
es.B: Ungirás la pila con su base, y la consagrarás.
es.R: Unge la pila de bronce y su base, y apártala para Dios.

fr.L: Et tu oindras la cuve et son support, et tu la consacreras.
fr.B: Tu oindras la cuve avec son support, et tu la consacreras.
fr.R: Oins la cuve de bronze et son support, et mets-la à part pour Dieu.

sw.L: Nawe utalipaka mafuta birika na kiweko chake, nawe utalitakasa.
sw.B: Utalipaka mafuta birika pamoja na kiweko chake, na kulitakasa.
sw.R: Lipake mafuta birika la shaba na kiweko chake, na ulitenge kwa ajili ya Mungu.

decisions.choice: its stand: the base the basin rested on
decisions.reason: The noun is the base or stand of the basin, also made of bronze (30:18; 38:8).

decisions.choice: set it apart for God
decisions.reason: Readable explains "consecrate", as in verse 9.

source.text: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֤ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֔יו אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְרָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will bring near Aaron and his sons to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting, and you will wash them with water.

en.L: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons near to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and you shall wash them with water.
en.B: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
en.R: Have Aaron and his sons come to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and wash them with water.

es.L: Y harás acercarse a Aarón y a sus hijos a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, y los lavarás con agua.
es.B: Llevarás a Aarón y a sus hijos a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro y los lavarás con agua.
es.R: Haz que Aarón y sus hijos vengan a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, y lávalos con agua.

fr.L: Et tu feras approcher Aaron et ses fils de l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, et tu les laveras avec de l’eau.
fr.B: Tu feras venir Aaron et ses fils à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, et tu les laveras avec de l’eau.
fr.R: Fais venir Aaron et ses fils à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, et lave-les avec de l’eau.

sw.L: Nawe utawasogeza Haruni na wanawe karibu na mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, nawe utawaosha kwa maji.
sw.B: Utawaleta Haruni na wanawe kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania na kuwaosha kwa maji.
sw.R: Walete Haruni na wanawe kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, uwaoshe kwa maji.

decisions.choice: wash them with water: the washing that began the priests' ordination
decisions.reason: These verses sum up the ordination of chapter 29 (29:4-9). The washing came first; Leviticus 8:6 tells how Moses did it.

source.text: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֖וֹ וְכִהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will clothe Aaron [with] the garments of holiness, and you will anoint him, and you will consecrate him, and he will serve as priest to me.

en.L: And you shall clothe Aaron [with] the garments of holiness, and anoint him and consecrate him, and he shall serve as priest to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: Dress Aaron in the holy garments, anoint him and consecrate him, so that he may serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as priest.
en.R: Put the holy clothes on Aaron. Anoint him and set him apart for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, so that he can serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as priest.

es.L: Y vestirás a Aarón [con] las vestiduras de santidad, y lo ungirás, y lo consagrarás, y ejercerá el sacerdocio para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.B: Vestirás a Aarón con las vestiduras sagradas, lo ungirás y lo consagrarás, para que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sirva como sacerdote.
es.R: Ponle a Aarón la ropa sagrada. Úngelo y apártalo para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, para que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pueda servir como sacerdote.

fr.L: Et tu revêtiras Aaron des vêtements de sainteté, et tu l’oindras, et tu le consacreras, et il exercera le sacerdoce pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: Tu revêtiras Aaron des vêtements sacrés, tu l’oindras et tu le consacreras, pour qu’il {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} serve comme prêtre.
fr.R: Habille Aaron avec les habits sacrés. Oins-le et mets-le à part pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, afin qu’il puisse {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servir comme prêtre.

sw.L: Nawe utamvika Haruni mavazi ya utakatifu, nawe utampaka mafuta, nawe utamtakasa, naye atahudumu kama kuhani {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}.
sw.B: Utamvika Haruni mavazi matakatifu, utampaka mafuta na kumtakasa, ili anitumikie kama kuhani.
sw.R: Mvike Haruni nguo takatifu. Mpake mafuta na umtenge kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ili aweze kunitumikia kama kuhani.

decisions.choice: the garments of holiness: the high priest's holy clothing
decisions.reason: These are the garments made for Aaron in chapter 28 (28:2-4): the ephod, breastpiece, robe, tunic, turban and sash.

decisions.choice: he will serve as priest to me: the purpose of the anointing
decisions.reason: The last verb states the result and purpose of the clothing and anointing: Aaron is set apart to serve God as priest.

decisions.choice: set him apart for me
decisions.reason: Readable explains "consecrate" by saying for whom Aaron is set apart.

source.text: וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And his sons you will bring near, and you will clothe them [with] tunics.

en.L: And his sons you shall bring near, and you shall clothe them [with] tunics.
en.B: Then bring his sons forward and put tunics on them.
en.R: Then have his sons come forward, and dress them in tunics.

es.L: Y a sus hijos los harás acercarse, y los vestirás [con] túnicas.
es.B: Luego harás que se acerquen sus hijos y les pondrás túnicas.
es.R: Después haz que vengan sus hijos, y vístelos con túnicas.

fr.L: Et ses fils, tu les feras approcher, et tu les revêtiras de tuniques.
fr.B: Puis tu feras avancer ses fils et tu les revêtiras de tuniques.
fr.R: Ensuite, fais venir ses fils et habille-les de tuniques.

sw.L: Na wanawe utawasogeza karibu, nawe utawavika kanzu.
sw.B: Kisha utawaleta wanawe mbele na kuwavika kanzu.
sw.R: Kisha walete wanawe, uwavike kanzu.

decisions.choice: tunics: the priests' long linen garments
decisions.reason: Aaron's sons wore linen tunics with sashes and caps (28:40), not the high priest's ephod and breastpiece.

source.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר מָשַׁ֨חְתָּ֙ אֶת־אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וְכִהֲנ֖וּ לִ֑י וְ֠הָיְתָה לִהְיֹ֨ת לָהֶ֧ם מָשְׁחָתָ֛ם לִכְהֻנַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will anoint them just as you anointed their father, and they will serve as priests to me; and it will be, to be to them their anointing for a priesthood of perpetuity to their generations.

en.L: And you shall anoint them just as you anointed their father, and they shall serve as priests to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; and their anointing shall be to them for a priesthood forever throughout their generations."
en.B: Anoint them as you anointed their father, so that they too may serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as priests. Their anointing will give them a priesthood that lasts for all time, through every generation."
en.R: Anoint them in the same way you anointed their father, so they can serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as priests. Because they are anointed, they and their descendants will be priests for all time."

es.L: Y los ungirás como ungiste a su padre, y ejercerán el sacerdocio para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; y su unción será para ellos un sacerdocio perpetuo por sus generaciones».
es.B: Los ungirás como ungiste a su padre, para que también ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sirvan como sacerdotes. Su unción les dará un sacerdocio que durará para siempre, generación tras generación».
es.R: Úngelos de la misma manera que ungiste a su padre, para que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} puedan servir como sacerdotes. Por haber sido ungidos, ellos y sus descendientes serán sacerdotes para siempre».

fr.L: Et tu les oindras comme tu as oint leur père, et ils exerceront le sacerdoce pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; et leur onction sera pour eux un sacerdoce perpétuel, au long de leurs générations. »
fr.B: Tu les oindras comme tu as oint leur père, pour qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servent eux aussi comme prêtres. Leur onction leur donnera un sacerdoce qui durera pour toujours, de génération en génération. »
fr.R: Oins-les de la même façon que tu as oint leur père, pour qu’ils puissent {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servir comme prêtres. Parce qu’ils auront reçu l’onction, eux et leurs descendants seront prêtres pour toujours. »

sw.L: Nawe utawapaka mafuta kama ulivyompaka baba yao, nao watahudumu kama makuhani {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}; na kupakwa mafuta kwao kutakuwa kwao ukuhani wa milele katika vizazi vyao vyote."
sw.B: Utawapaka mafuta kama ulivyompaka baba yao, ili wao pia wanitumikie kama makuhani. Kupakwa mafuta kwao kutawapa ukuhani wa kudumu milele, katika kila kizazi."
sw.R: Wapake mafuta vilevile kama ulivyompaka baba yao, ili waweze kunitumikia kama makuhani. Kwa kuwa wamepakwa mafuta, wao na wazao wao watakuwa makuhani milele."

decisions.choice: their anointing ... a priesthood forever: the priesthood belongs to their family for all time
decisions.reason: The anointing of these first priests established the priesthood in Aaron's family for the generations after them, as 29:9 says (also Numbers 25:13). "Forever" means for as long as Israel continues.

decisions.choice: it will be, to be: the anointing will serve as
decisions.reason: The verb is followed by its own infinitive, a heavy construction that states what the anointing will become for them: their lasting claim to the priesthood.

decisions.choice: they and their descendants
decisions.reason: Readable says that "throughout their generations" means the sons' descendants after them.

source.text: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And did Moses according to all that commanded Yahweh him; so he did.

en.L: And Moses did according to all that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded him; so he did.
en.B: Moses carried out all that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded him. That is just what he did.
en.R: Moses did everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} told him to do.

es.L: E hizo Moisés conforme a todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había mandado; así lo hizo.
es.B: Moisés cumplió todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había mandado. Eso es exactamente lo que hizo.
es.R: Moisés hizo todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo que hiciera.

fr.L: Et Moïse fit selon tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait ordonné ; ainsi il fit.
fr.B: Moïse exécuta tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait ordonné. C’est exactement ce qu’il fit.
fr.R: Moïse a fait tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait dit de faire.

sw.L: Naye Musa akafanya sawasawa na yote aliyomwamuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; ndivyo alivyofanya.
sw.B: Musa alitekeleza yote aliyoamriwa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hivyo ndivyo hasa alivyofanya.
sw.R: Musa alifanya kila kitu ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia afanye.

decisions.choice: did according to all ... so he did: Moses' full obedience, in Noah's words
decisions.reason: The same words are said of Noah building the ark (Genesis 6:22). As Noah built what saved life through the flood, Moses builds the place where God will live among his people. The verse sums up verses 17-33.

decisions.choice: so he did: an emphatic repetition
decisions.reason: The closing words repeat the verb to stress that Moses did exactly what he was told.

decisions.choice: one clause
decisions.reason: Readable makes the doubled statement a single sentence; Literal and Balanced keep the repetition.

source.text: וַיְהִ֞י בַּחֹ֧דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֛וֹן בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הוּקַ֖ם הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was in the month the first, in the year the second, on [the] first of the month, was set up the tabernacle.

en.L: And it came about in the first month, in the second year, on the first of the month, the tabernacle was set up.
en.B: In the second year, on the first day of the first month, the tabernacle was put up.
en.R: So the tabernacle was put up on the first day of the first month. This was in the second year after the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} left Egypt.

es.L: Y sucedió en el mes primero, en el año segundo, el primero del mes, que fue levantado el tabernáculo.
es.B: En el segundo año, el primer día del mes primero, se levantó el tabernáculo.
es.R: Así que el tabernáculo se levantó el primer día del primer mes. Esto fue en el segundo año después de que los israelitas salieron de Egipto.

fr.L: Et il arriva, au premier mois, en la deuxième année, le premier du mois, que la Demeure fut dressée.
fr.B: La deuxième année, le premier jour du premier mois, la Demeure fut dressée.
fr.R: Le tabernacle a donc été dressé le premier jour du premier mois. C’était dans la deuxième année après que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} étaient sortis d’Égypte.

sw.L: Ikawa katika mwezi wa kwanza, katika mwaka wa pili, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi, maskani ikasimamishwa.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa pili, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza, maskani ilisimamishwa.
sw.R: Basi maskani ilisimamishwa siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza. Ilikuwa katika mwaka wa pili tangu Waisraeli walipotoka Misri.

decisions.choice: the first month of the second year: nearly a year after the exodus
decisions.reason: The years are counted from the exodus (12:2; 19:1; Numbers 1:1). Israel left Egypt on the fifteenth day of the first month (Numbers 33:3) and came to Sinai in the third month (19:1). The tabernacle was put up two weeks short of a year after they left, and about nine months after they arrived at Sinai.

decisions.choice: was set up: the passive, before the active of verse 18
decisions.reason: The verse states the event; verses 18-33 tell how Moses did it. Numbers 7:1 and 9:15 refer back to this day.

decisions.choice: after the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} left Egypt
decisions.reason: Readable says from what the second year is counted.

source.text: וַיָּ֨קֶם מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־אֲדָנָ֔יו וַיָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶת־קְרָשָׁ֔יו וַיִּתֵּ֖ן אֶת־בְּרִיחָ֑יו וַיָּ֖קֶם אֶת־עַמּוּדָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And set up Moses the tabernacle, and he put its bases, and he set up its frames, and he put its bars, and he set up its pillars.

en.L: And Moses set up the tabernacle; and he put [in place] its bases, and set up its frames, and put [in] its bars, and set up its pillars.
en.B: Moses set up the tabernacle. He laid its bases, put its frames in place, fitted its crossbars and raised its pillars.
en.R: Moses set up the tabernacle. He put its bases in place and set its frames in them. He put in the crossbars and set up its posts.

es.L: Y levantó Moisés el tabernáculo; y puso sus basas, y colocó sus bastidores, y puso sus travesaños, y levantó sus columnas.
es.B: Moisés levantó el tabernáculo. Asentó sus basas, colocó sus bastidores, ajustó sus travesaños y alzó sus columnas.
es.R: Moisés levantó el tabernáculo. Puso las basas en su lugar y encajó en ellas los bastidores. Colocó los travesaños y levantó los postes.

fr.L: Et Moïse dressa la Demeure ; et il posa ses socles, et plaça ses châssis, et mit ses traverses, et dressa ses colonnes.
fr.B: Moïse dressa la Demeure. Il posa ses socles, mit ses châssis en place, ajusta ses traverses et éleva ses colonnes.
fr.R: Moïse a dressé le tabernacle. Il a mis les socles en place et il y a fixé les châssis. Il a mis les traverses et il a dressé les poteaux.

sw.L: Naye Musa akaisimamisha maskani; akaweka misingi yake, akazisimamisha fremu zake, akaweka mataruma yake, akazisimamisha nguzo zake.
sw.B: Musa aliisimamisha maskani. Aliweka misingi yake, akazisimika fremu zake, akatia mataruma yake na kuzisimamisha nguzo zake.
sw.R: Musa aliisimamisha maskani. Aliweka misingi mahali pake, akasimika fremu ndani yake. Akatia mataruma, akasimamisha nguzo.

decisions.choice: bases, frames, bars, pillars: the framework of the tent
decisions.reason: The silver bases held the upright frames, the bars held the frames together, and the pillars held the veil and the entrance screen (26:15-37).

decisions.choice: crossbars
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "crossbars", as in 26:26; Literal keeps "bars".

decisions.choice: posts
decisions.reason: Readable says "posts" for the pillars, as in 27:16.

source.text: וַיִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אֶת־הָאֹ֨הֶל֙ עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וַיָּ֜שֶׂם אֶת־מִכְסֵ֥ה הָאֹ֛הֶל עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he spread out the tent over the tabernacle, and he put [the] covering of the tent over it from above, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle, and he put the covering of the tent over it, above, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: He spread the tent over the tabernacle and laid the covering of the tent on top of it, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: He spread the outer tent of goats' hair over the tabernacle and put the leather coverings over that. He did it all just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

es.L: Y extendió la tienda sobre el tabernáculo, y puso la cubierta de la tienda sobre ella, encima, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Extendió la tienda sobre el tabernáculo y colocó encima la cubierta de la tienda, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Extendió sobre el tabernáculo la tienda exterior de pelo de cabra y puso encima las cubiertas de cuero. Lo hizo todo tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.

fr.L: Et il étendit la tente sur la Demeure, et il mit la couverture de la tente sur elle, par-dessus, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Il déploya la tente au-dessus de la Demeure et posa par-dessus la couverture de la tente, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Il a étendu sur le tabernacle la tente extérieure en poil de chèvre, et il a mis les couvertures de cuir par-dessus. Il a tout fait exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: Naye akalitandaza hema juu ya maskani, akaweka kifuniko cha hema juu yake, kwa juu, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Alilitandaza hema juu ya maskani, akaweka kifuniko cha hema juu yake, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Alitandaza hema la nje la manyoya ya mbuzi juu ya maskani, akaweka vifuniko vya ngozi juu yake. Alifanya yote kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: the tent ... the covering of the tent: the layers over the tabernacle
decisions.reason: "The tabernacle" here is the inner layer of linen curtains; "the tent" is the layer of goats' hair curtains over it (26:1, 7); "the covering" is the rams' skins and fine leather on top (26:14).

decisions.choice: just as Yahweh had commanded Moses: a refrain heard seven times
decisions.reason: The words close each step of the setting up, seven times in all (verses 19, 21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 32), as the same refrain marks the making of the priests' garments (39:1-31). Seven steps, like the seven days of creation, lead to the finished work of verse 33.

decisions.choice: outer tent of goats' hair ... leather coverings
decisions.reason: Readable says what the tent and the covering were made of (26:7, 14).

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֞ח וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־הָעֵדֻת֙ אֶל־הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֖ים עַל־הָאָרֹ֑ן וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל־הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and he put the poles on the ark, and he put the mercy seat on the ark from above.

en.L: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and he set the poles on the ark, and he put the mercy seat on the ark, above.
en.B: He took the testimony and placed it in the ark, fitted the poles to the ark, and set the mercy seat on top of the ark.
en.R: He took the covenant tablets and put them inside the ark. He put the poles in place on the ark. Then he put the lid of the ark, the place where sins are covered, on top of the ark.

es.L: Y tomó y puso el Testimonio en el arca, y colocó las barras en el arca, y puso el propiciatorio sobre el arca, encima.
es.B: Tomó el Testimonio y lo colocó en el arca, ajustó las barras al arca y puso el propiciatorio encima del arca.
es.R: Tomó las tablas del pacto y las puso dentro del arca. Colocó las barras en el arca. Luego puso encima del arca la tapa, que es el lugar donde se cubren los pecados.

fr.L: Et il prit et mit le Témoignage dans l’arche, et il plaça les barres sur l’arche, et il mit le propitiatoire sur l’arche, par-dessus.
fr.B: Il prit le Témoignage et le plaça dans l’arche, fixa les barres à l’arche et posa le propitiatoire sur le dessus de l’arche.
fr.R: Il a pris les tablettes de l’alliance et il les a mises dans l’arche. Il a mis les barres en place sur l’arche. Puis il a posé sur l’arche le couvercle, là où les péchés sont couverts.

sw.L: Naye akatwaa akaweka Ushuhuda ndani ya sanduku, akaiweka mipiko kwenye sanduku, akaweka kiti cha rehema juu ya sanduku, kwa juu.
sw.B: Aliuchukua Ushuhuda akauweka ndani ya sanduku, akaitia mipiko kwenye sanduku, na kuweka kiti cha rehema juu ya sanduku.
sw.R: Alivichukua vibao vya agano akaviweka ndani ya sanduku. Akaitia mipiko mahali pake kwenye sanduku. Kisha akaweka juu ya sanduku kifuniko chake, mahali dhambi zinapofunikwa.

decisions.choice: the testimony: the stone tablets of the covenant
decisions.reason: "The testimony" is the two tablets with the Ten Words written on them (25:16; 31:18; 34:28-29), which bore witness to the covenant.

decisions.choice: the mercy seat: the gold lid of the ark, the place of atonement
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb for making atonement. It was the gold cover of the ark, with the cherubim above it, where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement (25:17-22; Leviticus 16:14-15).

decisions.choice: the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the testimony" is, as in 25:16.

decisions.choice: the lid of the ark, the place where sins are covered
decisions.reason: Readable explains "mercy seat", as in 25:17.

source.text: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֶת־הָאָרֹן֮ אֶל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֒ וַיָּ֗שֶׂם אֵ֚ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַמָּסָ֔ךְ וַיָּ֕סֶךְ עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and he set up the veil of the screen, and he screened over [the] ark of the testimony, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the testimony, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: He brought the ark into the tabernacle and hung the curtain that serves as a screen, shutting off the ark of the testimony from view, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: He brought the ark into the tabernacle and hung the inner curtain to shut off the ark that holds the covenant tablets. He did it all just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

es.L: Y metió el arca en el tabernáculo, y levantó el velo de la cortina, y ocultó el arca del Testimonio, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Metió el arca en el tabernáculo y colgó la cortina interior que sirve de separación, ocultando a la vista el arca del Testimonio, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Metió el arca en el tabernáculo y colgó la cortina interior para ocultar el arca donde están las tablas del pacto. Lo hizo todo tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.

fr.L: Et il fit entrer l’arche dans la Demeure, et il dressa le voile du rideau, et il masqua l’arche du Témoignage, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Il fit entrer l’arche dans la Demeure et suspendit le rideau intérieur qui sert d’écran, pour cacher aux regards l’arche du Témoignage, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Il a apporté l’arche dans le tabernacle et il a suspendu le rideau intérieur pour cacher l’arche où se trouvent les tablettes de l’alliance. Il a tout fait exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: Naye akaliingiza sanduku ndani ya maskani, akalisimamisha pazia la kusitiri, akalisitiri sanduku la Ushuhuda, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Aliliingiza sanduku ndani ya maskani, akatundika pazia la ndani linalolisitiri, ili sanduku la Ushuhuda lisionekane, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Aliliingiza sanduku ndani ya maskani, akatundika pazia la ndani ili kulificha sanduku lenye vibao vya agano. Alifanya yote kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: the veil of the screen: the veil that served as a screen
decisions.reason: The phrase names the veil by its purpose (35:12; 39:34): it screened the most holy place, where the ark stood, from the rest of the tent.

decisions.choice: curtain
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "curtain" (Readable "inner curtain"); Literal keeps "veil".

decisions.choice: the ark that holds the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the ark of the testimony" is.

es.R: Puso la mesa en la Tienda del Encuentro, en el lado norte del tabernáculo, por fuera de la cortina interior.

decisions.reason: The table stood in the outer room, the holy place, on the right as one faced the veil from the entrance on the east (26:35).

es.L: Y dispuso en orden sobre ella un arreglo de pan delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Colocó sobre ella el pan en hileras delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Puso el pan en hileras sobre la mesa, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Lo hizo tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.

fr.L: Et il disposa en ordre sur elle un arrangement de pain devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Il y disposa le pain en rangées devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Il a disposé le pain en rangées sur la table, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il a fait cela exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: Naye akapanga juu yake mpangilio wa mikate mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Aliipanga mikate juu yake kwa safu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Alipanga mikate kwa safu juu ya meza mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Alifanya hivyo kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: an arrangement of bread: the bread of the Presence in rows
decisions.reason: This is the bread of the Presence (25:30), twelve loaves set out in two rows on the table before God (Leviticus 24:5-8).

decisions.choice: set out ... in rows
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say how the bread was arranged; Literal keeps "set in order ... an arrangement".

decisions.choice: the lampstand on the south side: facing the table
decisions.reason: The gold lampstand stood in the holy place opposite the table, as 26:35 directed, giving light in the tent that had no window.

fr.B: Il mit en place les lampes devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Il a mis les lampes en place devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il a fait cela exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.B: Alizipandisha taa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Aliweka taa mahali pake mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Alifanya hivyo kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: set up the lamps: mount them, or light them
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up. It may mean placing the lamps on the lampstand (25:37) or lighting them so that their flame goes up (as in Numbers 8:2-3). Both happened as the tent was set up.

decisions.reason: The small altar overlaid with gold, for incense (30:1-6), stood in the holy place just outside the veil, facing the ark behind it.

decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "curtain"; Literal keeps "veil".

decisions.choice: hung
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say how a screen is set up; Literal keeps "set up".

source.text: וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה שָׂ֕ם פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֣ן אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיַּ֣עַל עָלָ֗יו אֶת־הָעֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And [the] altar of the burnt offering he set [at the] entrance of [the] tabernacle of [the] tent of meeting, and he offered up on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And the altar of burnt offering he set [at] the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and he offered up on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: He set the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: He set up the altar for burnt offerings near the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting. On it he offered the burnt offering and the grain offering. He did this just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

es.L: Y el altar del holocausto lo puso [a] la entrada del tabernáculo de la Tienda del Encuentro, y ofreció sobre él el holocausto y la ofrenda de cereal, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Puso el altar del holocausto a la entrada del tabernáculo, la Tienda del Encuentro, y ofreció sobre él el holocausto y la ofrenda de cereal, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Colocó el altar para los holocaustos cerca de la entrada del tabernáculo, la Tienda del Encuentro. Sobre él ofreció el holocausto y la ofrenda de cereal. Lo hizo tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.

fr.L: Et l’autel de l’holocauste, il le plaça [à] l’entrée de la Demeure de la tente de la Rencontre, et il offrit sur lui l’holocauste et l’offrande végétale, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Il plaça l’autel de l’holocauste à l’entrée de la Demeure, la tente de la Rencontre, et y offrit l’holocauste et l’offrande végétale, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Il a installé l’autel des holocaustes près de l’entrée du tabernacle, la tente de la Rencontre. Il y a offert l’holocauste et l’offrande végétale. Il a fait cela exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: Na madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa akaiweka [penye] mlango wa maskani ya Hema la Kukutania, akatoa juu yake sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka ya nafaka, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Aliiweka madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa penye mlango wa maskani, yaani Hema la Kukutania, akatoa juu yake sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka ya nafaka, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Aliweka madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketezwa karibu na mlango wa maskani, yaani Hema la Kukutania. Juu yake alitoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka ya nafaka. Alifanya hivyo kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: he offered the burnt offering and the grain offering: the first offerings on the altar
decisions.reason: Moses himself made the first offerings, before Aaron and his sons were ordained (Leviticus 8). The burnt offering with its grain offering was the regular daily offering of 29:38-42.

decisions.choice: He set the altar ...
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the subject and verb first; Literal keeps the Hebrew order, which puts the altar first.

source.text: וַיָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן שָׁ֛מָּה מַ֖יִם לְרָחְצָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he put the basin between [the] tent of meeting and the altar, and he put there water for washing.

en.L: And he put the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and he put water there for washing.
en.B: Between the tent of meeting and the altar he placed the basin, and he filled it with water for washing.
en.R: He put the bronze basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and filled it with water for washing.

es.L: Y puso la pila entre la Tienda del Encuentro y el altar, y puso allí agua para lavarse.
es.B: Entre la Tienda del Encuentro y el altar colocó la pila, y la llenó de agua para los lavamientos.
es.R: Puso la pila de bronce entre la Tienda del Encuentro y el altar, y la llenó de agua para lavarse.

fr.L: Et il plaça la cuve entre la tente de la Rencontre et l’autel, et il y mit de l’eau pour se laver.
fr.B: Entre la tente de la Rencontre et l’autel, il plaça la cuve, et il la remplit d’eau pour les ablutions.
fr.R: Il a mis la cuve de bronze entre la tente de la Rencontre et l’autel, et il l’a remplie d’eau pour se laver.

sw.L: Naye akaliweka birika kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, akatia humo maji kwa ajili ya kunawa.
sw.B: Kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu aliliweka birika, akalijaza maji ya kunawia.
sw.R: Aliweka birika la shaba kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, akalijaza maji ya kunawa.

decisions.choice: the basin ... for washing: water for the priests before they served
decisions.reason: The water was for the priests to wash before entering the tent or serving at the altar (30:19-21).

decisions.choice: bronze
decisions.reason: Readable adds what the basin was made of (30:18).

source.text: וְרָחֲצ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And washed from it Moses and Aaron and his sons their hands and their feet.

en.L: And Moses and Aaron and his sons would wash their hands and their feet from it.
en.B: Moses, Aaron and Aaron's sons would wash their hands and feet with water from it.
en.R: Moses, Aaron and Aaron's sons used it to wash their hands and feet.

es.L: Y Moisés y Aarón y sus hijos lavaban de ella sus manos y sus pies.
es.B: Moisés, Aarón y los hijos de Aarón se lavaban las manos y los pies con agua de la pila.
es.R: Moisés, Aarón y los hijos de Aarón la usaban para lavarse las manos y los pies.

fr.L: Et Moïse et Aaron et ses fils y lavaient leurs mains et leurs pieds.
fr.B: Moïse, Aaron et les fils d’Aaron s’y lavaient les mains et les pieds avec l’eau qu’elle contenait.
fr.R: Moïse, Aaron et les fils d’Aaron s’en servaient pour se laver les mains et les pieds.

sw.L: Na Musa na Haruni na wanawe walikuwa wakinawa humo mikono yao na miguu yao.
sw.B: Musa, Haruni na wana wa Haruni walikuwa wakinawa mikono na miguu yao kwa maji ya birika hilo.
sw.R: Musa, Haruni na wana wa Haruni walilitumia kunawa mikono na miguu yao.

decisions.choice: washed: a regular practice
decisions.reason: The form of the verb most likely describes what they did each time, as verse 32 goes on to say. It may also describe a single washing on the day the tabernacle was set up.

decisions.choice: Moses with Aaron and his sons: Moses served as priest at the ordination
decisions.reason: Moses is named with the priests because he served at the altar during the ordination (Leviticus 8:14-30).

decisions.choice: imparfait "lavaient", "se lavaient", "s'en servaient" at every level
alternatives: passé simple "lavèrent" (L, B), passé composé "ont lavé" (R)
decisions.reason: The narrative tenses give way to the imparfait because the verse most likely describes what they did each time (m1), as verse 32 goes on to say; the passé simple would point to a single washing on the day the tabernacle was set up.

source.text: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וּבְקָרְבָתָ֛ם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִרְחָ֑צוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: When they went into [the] tent of meeting and when they drew near to the altar, they would wash, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: When they went into the tent of meeting, and when they drew near to the altar, they would wash, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: Each time they went into the tent of meeting or came near the altar, they washed, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: They washed every time they went into the tent of meeting or came near the altar. This was just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

es.L: Cuando entraban en la Tienda del Encuentro, y cuando se acercaban al altar, se lavaban, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Cada vez que entraban en la Tienda del Encuentro o se acercaban al altar, se lavaban, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Se lavaban cada vez que entraban en la Tienda del Encuentro o se acercaban al altar. Así lo había mandado {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Moisés.

fr.L: Quand ils entraient dans la tente de la Rencontre, et quand ils s’approchaient de l’autel, ils se lavaient, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Chaque fois qu’ils entraient dans la tente de la Rencontre ou s’approchaient de l’autel, ils se lavaient, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Ils se lavaient chaque fois qu’ils entraient dans la tente de la Rencontre ou qu’ils s’approchaient de l’autel. Ils le faisaient comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: Walipokuwa wakiingia ndani ya Hema la Kukutania, na walipokuwa wakiikaribia madhabahu, walikuwa wakinawa, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Kila walipoingia ndani ya Hema la Kukutania au kuikaribia madhabahu, walinawa, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Walinawa kila mara walipoingia katika Hema la Kukutania au walipoikaribia madhabahu. Ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: they would wash, as commanded: obeying 30:19-21
decisions.reason: The washing follows the command of 30:19-21, which warned that the priests must wash so that they would not die. This is the seventh time the refrain "just as Yahweh had commanded Moses" is heard.

source.text: וַיָּ֣קֶם אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֗ר סָבִיב֙ לַמִּשְׁכָּ֣ן וְלַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיִּתֵּ֕ן אֶת־מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֑ר וַיְכַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And he set up the courtyard all around the tabernacle and the altar, and he put the screen of [the] gate of the courtyard. And finished Moses the work.

en.L: And he set up the courtyard all around the tabernacle and the altar, and he put [up] the screen of the gate of the courtyard. And Moses completed the work.
en.B: He put up the courtyard all around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung the screen for the courtyard gate. So Moses completed the work.
en.R: He set up the courtyard all around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung the screen at the courtyard's gate. So Moses finished the work.

es.L: Y levantó el atrio alrededor del tabernáculo y del altar, y puso [en su lugar] la cortina de la puerta del atrio. Y acabó Moisés la obra.
es.B: Levantó el atrio todo alrededor del tabernáculo y del altar, y colgó la cortina de la puerta del atrio. Así concluyó Moisés la obra.
es.R: Armó el atrio alrededor del tabernáculo y del altar, y colgó la cortina en la puerta del atrio. Así terminó Moisés el trabajo.

fr.L: Et il dressa le parvis tout autour de la Demeure et de l’autel, et il mit [en place] le rideau de la porte du parvis. Et Moïse acheva l’ouvrage.
fr.B: Il installa le parvis tout autour de la Demeure et de l’autel, et suspendit le rideau à la porte du parvis. Ainsi Moïse acheva l’ouvrage.
fr.R: Il a installé le parvis tout autour du tabernacle et de l’autel, et il a suspendu le rideau à la porte du parvis. Ainsi, Moïse a terminé le travail.

sw.L: Naye akausimamisha ua kuizunguka maskani na madhabahu, akaweka [mahali pake] pazia la lango la ua. Naye Musa akaimaliza kazi.
sw.B: Aliusimamisha ua kuizunguka maskani na madhabahu pande zote, akatundika pazia la lango la ua. Hivyo Musa akaikamilisha kazi.
sw.R: Alisimamisha ua kuizunguka maskani na madhabahu, akatundika pazia kwenye lango la ua. Hivyo Musa akamaliza kazi.

decisions.choice: Moses completed the work: an echo of God completing his work at creation
decisions.reason: The verb and the noun are the ones used when God completed his work on the seventh day (Genesis 2:2). The account of the tabernacle already echoes creation: Moses saw all the work, that it was done as commanded, and blessed the people (39:32, 43; compare Genesis 1:31; 2:1-3). The tent where God will live among his people is presented as a new creation.

decisions.choice: and Moses completed: the close of the work
decisions.reason: The short clause ends the account of the building begun in chapter 35 and leads straight into God's coming to fill the tent (verse 34).

source.text: וַיְכַ֥ס הֶעָנָ֖ן אֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And covered the cloud [the] tent of meeting, and [the] glory of Yahweh filled the tabernacle.

en.L: And the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled the tabernacle.
en.B: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the tabernacle was filled with the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the tabernacle became full of the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y cubrió la nube la Tienda del Encuentro, y la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llenó el tabernáculo.
es.B: Entonces la nube cubrió la Tienda del Encuentro, y el tabernáculo quedó lleno de la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Entonces la nube cubrió la Tienda del Encuentro, y el tabernáculo se llenó de la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et la nuée couvrit la tente de la Rencontre, et la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplit la Demeure.
fr.B: Alors la nuée couvrit la tente de la Rencontre, et la Demeure fut remplie de la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors le nuage a couvert la tente de la Rencontre, et le tabernacle s’est rempli de la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kisha wingu likalifunika Hema la Kukutania, nao utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukaijaza maskani.
sw.B: Ndipo wingu likalifunika Hema la Kukutania, na maskani ikajazwa utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kisha wingu lilifunika Hema la Kukutania, na maskani ikajaa utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: the glory of Yahweh filled the tabernacle: God comes to dwell among his people
decisions.reason: This is what the whole tabernacle was made for. God told Moses, "Let them make me a sanctuary, so that I may dwell among them" (25:8), and promised, "I will dwell among the sons of Israel and be their God" (29:45-46). Now he does: his glory, his visible presence, fills the dwelling built for him. After the golden calf, when his presence among the people was in doubt (33:3, 15-16), this is the proof that he has forgiven them and will go with them. The same happens when Solomon's temple is finished (1 Kings 8:10-11).

decisions.choice: the cloud covered ... the glory: what happened on Sinai now happens at the tent
decisions.reason: At Sinai the cloud covered the mountain, the glory of Yahweh settled on it, and Moses went up into the cloud (24:15-18). The same cloud and glory now come down on the tent, so that the presence once on the mountain goes with Israel wherever they travel.

decisions.choice: the cloud: the pillar of cloud
decisions.reason: The article points to the known cloud, the pillar of cloud that had led Israel since they left Egypt (13:21-22; 14:19-20; 16:10).

source.text: וְלֹא־יָכֹ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לָבוֹא֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד כִּֽי־שָׁכַ֥ן עָלָ֖יו הֶעָנָ֑ן וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And not was able Moses to go into [the] tent of meeting, because had settled over it the cloud, and [the] glory of Yahweh filled the tabernacle.

en.L: And Moses was not able to go into the tent of meeting, because the cloud had settled on it and the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled the tabernacle.
en.B: Moses was unable to go into the tent of meeting, since the cloud had come to rest on it and the tabernacle was full of the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Moses could not go inside the tent of meeting. The cloud had come to stay on it, and the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled the tabernacle.

es.L: Y no pudo Moisés entrar en la Tienda del Encuentro, porque la nube moraba sobre ella, y la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llenaba el tabernáculo.
es.B: Moisés no podía entrar en la Tienda del Encuentro, porque la nube se había posado sobre ella y el tabernáculo estaba lleno de la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Moisés no pudo entrar en la Tienda del Encuentro. La nube se había quedado sobre ella, y la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llenaba el tabernáculo.

fr.L: Et Moïse ne put entrer dans la tente de la Rencontre, car la nuée demeurait sur elle, et la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplissait la Demeure.
fr.B: Moïse ne pouvait pas entrer dans la tente de la Rencontre, car la nuée s’y était posée pour y demeurer, et la Demeure était pleine de la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Moïse n’a pas pu entrer dans la tente de la Rencontre. Le nuage s’était installé sur elle pour y rester, et la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplissait le tabernacle.

sw.L: Wala Musa hakuweza kuingia ndani ya Hema la Kukutania, kwa sababu wingu lilikuwa limekaa juu yake, na utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulikuwa umeijaza maskani.
sw.B: Musa hakuweza kuingia ndani ya Hema la Kukutania, kwa kuwa wingu lilikuwa limetua juu yake, na maskani ilikuwa imejaa utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Musa hakuweza kuingia katika Hema la Kukutania. Wingu lilikuwa limekuja kukaa juu yake, na utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulijaa ndani ya maskani.

decisions.choice: settled: came to rest and stay
decisions.reason: The verb means to settle and dwell. It is the root of the word "tabernacle" (dwelling) and the verb of God's promise to dwell among his people (25:8; 29:45-46). The same verb is used of the glory settling on Sinai (24:16).

decisions.choice: Moses was not able to enter: the glory is too great even for Moses
decisions.reason: On Sinai Moses went into the cloud (24:18), but here even he cannot enter while the glory fills the tent. The next book begins with God calling to Moses from the tent of meeting (Leviticus 1:1), and the same thing happens to the priests at the temple (1 Kings 8:11).

decisions.choice: had come to stay
decisions.reason: Readable says that the cloud came to remain, not only to stop for a moment.

decisions.choice: "demeurait" (L), "s'y était posée pour y demeurer" (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the root of the word for the tabernacle (m1); "demeurer" keeps that link with "la Demeure" in the same verse. Readable says plainly "s'était installé ... pour y rester", as the English "had come to stay".

source.text: וּבְהֵעָל֤וֹת הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעַ֣ל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּכֹ֖ל מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And when was taken up the cloud from over the tabernacle, set out [the] sons of Israel in all their settings out.

en.L: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel would set out, in all their journeys.
en.B: Whenever the cloud rose from over the tabernacle, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} broke camp and moved on, at every stage of their journeys.
en.R: Whenever the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} packed up their camp and moved on. They did this all through their travels.

es.L: Y cuando la nube se alzaba de sobre el tabernáculo, los hijos de Israel partían, en todas sus jornadas.
es.B: Siempre que la nube se elevaba de encima del tabernáculo, los israelitas levantaban el campamento y seguían adelante, en cada etapa de sus viajes.
es.R: Cada vez que la nube se levantaba de encima del tabernáculo, los israelitas recogían su campamento y se ponían en marcha. Así lo hicieron durante todos sus viajes.

fr.L: Et quand la nuée s’élevait de dessus la Demeure, les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël partaient, dans toutes leurs étapes.
fr.B: Chaque fois que la nuée s’élevait au-dessus de la Demeure, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} levaient le camp et repartaient, à chaque étape de leurs voyages.
fr.R: Chaque fois que le nuage se levait au-dessus du tabernacle, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} pliaient leur camp et se remettaient en route. Ils ont fait ainsi pendant tous leurs voyages.

sw.L: Na wingu lilipoinuliwa kutoka juu ya maskani, wana wa Israeli walikuwa wakisafiri, katika safari zao zote.
sw.B: Kila wingu lilipoinuka kutoka juu ya maskani, Waisraeli walivunja kambi na kuendelea na safari, katika kila hatua ya safari zao.
sw.R: Kila wingu lilipoondoka juu ya maskani, Waisraeli walikunja kambi yao na kuondoka. Walifanya hivyo katika safari zao zote.

decisions.choice: set out: pull up stakes and move on
decisions.reason: The verb means to pull up tent pegs and break camp. The related noun at the end of the verse means the stages of a journey, from one camp to the next.

decisions.choice: when ... in all their journeys: what happened every time
decisions.reason: The verse describes a regular pattern, not a single event: at every stage of their travels the people waited for the cloud. Verses 36-38 look past the end of the book to the whole journey through the wilderness.

decisions.choice: broke camp and moved on
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what setting out involved; Literal keeps "set out".

source.text: וְאִם־לֹ֥א יֵעָלֶ֖ה הֶעָנָ֑ן וְלֹ֣א יִסְע֔וּ עַד־י֖וֹם הֵעָלֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And if not was taken up the cloud, then not they set out until [the] day it was taken up.

en.L: And if the cloud was not taken up, then they would not set out until the day it was taken up.
en.B: If the cloud stayed where it was, they stayed too, until the day it rose.
en.R: If the cloud did not lift, they stayed where they were. They waited until the day it lifted.

es.L: Y si la nube no se alzaba, no partían hasta el día en que se alzaba.
es.B: Si la nube se quedaba donde estaba, ellos también se quedaban, hasta el día en que se elevaba.
es.R: Si la nube no se levantaba, ellos se quedaban donde estaban. Esperaban hasta el día en que se levantaba.

fr.L: Et si la nuée ne s’élevait pas, ils ne partaient pas jusqu’au jour où elle s’élevait.
fr.B: Si la nuée restait en place, eux aussi restaient, jusqu’au jour où elle s’élevait.
fr.R: Si le nuage ne se levait pas, ils restaient où ils étaient. Ils attendaient jusqu’au jour où il se levait.

sw.L: Na kama wingu halikuinuliwa, hawakusafiri hadi siku ile lilipoinuliwa.
sw.B: Kama wingu lilibaki pale lilipokuwa, nao walibaki, hadi siku lilipoinuka.
sw.R: Kama wingu halikuondoka, walikaa pale walipokuwa. Walingoja hadi siku lilipoondoka.

decisions.choice: if not ... until the day: they waited for the cloud
decisions.reason: The verse is the other half of verse 36: the people did not move until God moved. Numbers 9:19-22 tells how they stayed for days, months or longer while the cloud remained.

decisions.choice: stayed too
decisions.reason: Balanced says what not setting out meant, staying in camp; Literal keeps "would not set out".

source.text: כִּי֩ עֲנַ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה עַֽל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְאֵ֕שׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַ֖יְלָה בּ֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י כָל־בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל־מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For [the] cloud of Yahweh [was] over the tabernacle by day, and fire was by night in it, to [the] eyes of all [the] house of Israel in all their journeys.

en.L: For the cloud of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [was] over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in it by night, before the eyes of all the house of Israel, in all their journeys.
en.B: By day the cloud of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rested over the tabernacle, and by night fire glowed within it. The whole house of Israel could see it, at every stage of their travels.
en.R: During the day the cloud of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stayed over the tabernacle, and at night there was fire in the cloud. All the people of Israel could see it the whole time they traveled.

es.L: Porque la nube {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [estaba] sobre el tabernáculo de día, y fuego había en ella de noche, a los ojos de toda la casa de Israel, en todas sus jornadas.
es.B: De día la nube {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} reposaba sobre el tabernáculo, y de noche ardía un fuego dentro de ella. Toda la casa de Israel podía verlo, en cada etapa de sus viajes.
es.R: Durante el día, la nube {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se quedaba sobre el tabernáculo, y por la noche había fuego en la nube. Todo el pueblo de Israel podía verlo durante todo el tiempo que viajaron.

fr.L: Car la nuée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [était] sur la Demeure de jour, et un feu était en elle de nuit, aux yeux de toute la maison d’Israël, dans toutes leurs étapes.
fr.B: Le jour, la nuée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} reposait sur la Demeure, et la nuit, un feu brillait en elle. Toute la maison d’Israël pouvait les voir, à chaque étape de ses voyages.
fr.R: Pendant la journée, le nuage {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} restait au-dessus du tabernacle, et pendant la nuit, il y avait du feu dans le nuage. Tout le peuple d’Israël pouvait le voir, pendant tout le temps de ses voyages.

sw.L: Kwa maana wingu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [lilikuwa] juu ya maskani mchana, na moto ulikuwa ndani yake usiku, machoni pa nyumba yote ya Israeli, katika safari zao zote.
sw.B: Mchana wingu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilikaa juu ya maskani, na usiku moto uling'aa ndani yake. Nyumba yote ya Israeli iliweza kuona hayo, katika kila hatua ya safari zao.
sw.R: Wakati wa mchana wingu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilikaa juu ya maskani, na wakati wa usiku kulikuwa na moto ndani ya wingu hilo. Watu wote wa Israeli waliweza kuliona muda wote wa safari zao.

decisions.choice: the cloud of Yahweh ... in all their journeys: the book ends with God present and leading
decisions.reason: Exodus began with Israel enslaved in Egypt, building cities for Pharaoh (1:11). It ends with Israel free, and with God living in the tent they built for him, seen by the whole people day and night, leading them on. The verse looks ahead past Sinai: Numbers 9:15-23 tells the same story in more detail, and Numbers 10:11-12 tells of the first time the cloud lifted and Israel set out from Sinai.

decisions.choice: fire was in it: in the cloud
decisions.reason: "It" most likely refers to the cloud, which shone with fire at night, as the pillar of cloud and fire did from the start (13:21-22; Numbers 9:15-16). It may also refer to the tabernacle, over which the fire appeared.

decisions.choice: to the eyes of all the house of Israel: in plain sight of the whole people
decisions.reason: "To the eyes of" means in full view of. "The house of Israel" is the whole people, Israel's household.

decisions.choice: all the people of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says "people" for "house"; Literal and Balanced keep "house of Israel".

decisions.choice: glowed
decisions.reason: Balanced describes the fire at night; Literal says only that fire "was" in it.
